name: Global Spread-F Ionogram Dataset
description: This dataset supports seven-class spread-F morphology classification using ground-based ionosonde observations from stations in China, Russia, Brazil, Peru, and Ascension Island during selected periods of 2002–2016. Data were obtained from the Chinese Meridian Project, GIRO/DIDBase, and Russian institutional exchanges. Processing included cropping, proportional padding, removal of peripheral annotations, and resizing to 448 × 448 RGB pixels over a common domain of 0–17 MHz in frequency and 80–900 km in virtual height. Labels combine expert annotation and unanimous nine-classifier consensus; morphology-preserving augmentation was used during benchmark construction. The release contains four CSV files: a full-archive index with 1,446,483 records, training–validation records with 320,000 samples, and Test1 and Test2 with 7,000 samples each. It also provides 517,331 processed Hainan ionograms in PNG format. Each CSV row represents a source observation or benchmark sample, and column headers identify filenames, stations, observation times, sources, access links, labels, partition assignments, and applicable augmentation and review information. Spatial coverage is station-based, while temporal coverage and sampling vary among stations. Timestamps retain their original time conventions and minute- or second-level precision; no uniform sampling interval or native instrumental resolution is specified. Missing or inapplicable fields are blank, including unavailable seconds.
